Imported track did not appear immediately in /admin/trilhas list after dialog close (page cached); refresh picks it up. Consider invalidating the tracks query on import success. Low priority — API DELETE confirmed the track was created and findable.
Versions page still formats sizes as 'KB' with one decimal only — consider showing bytes for <1KB artifacts (test track showed 916B packed via API but UI would round to 0.9 KB).
No TTL index on login_attempts collection (carried over from iteration 1-2) — self-pruning still absent.
